SELECT `post_email_blasts`.* FROM `post_email_blasts` WHERE `post_email_blasts`.`completed_at` IS NULL AND `post_email_blasts`.`expired_at` IS NULL AND `post_email_blasts`.`requested_at` BETWEEN '2026-10-21 12:30:45.123000' AND '2026-11-04 08:30:45.123000' ORDER BY `post_email_blasts`.`requested_at` DESC LIMIT 501
